Perplexity Pro
Perplexity Assistant
Perplexity Computer
[[Perplexity Comet]]{{cite news |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/10/03/perplexity-comet-browser-ai-launch |title=Perplexity launches Comet, its first browser with AI search |first=David |last=Pierce |newspaper=The Verge |date=2024-10-03 |access-date=2025-08-03}} | num_employees = | website = {{URL|https://perplexity.ai}} }} '''Perplexity AI, Inc.''', or simply '''Perplexity''', is an American [[privately held company|privately held]] software company offering a web [[search engine]] that [[Natural language processing|process]]es user queries and synthesizes responses.{{Cite news|title=What is Perplexity AI and why is it stirring controversy?|url=https://www.euronews.com/next/2024/10/24/googles-latest-rival-what-is-perplexity-ai-and-why-is-it-causing-so-much-controversy|work=euronews|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241213184900/https://www.euronews.com/next/2024/10/24/googles-latest-rival-what-is-perplexity-ai-and-why-is-it-causing-so-much-controversy|archive-date=2024-12-13|language=en-GB}} Perplexity products use [[large language model]]s and incorporate real-time web search capabilities, providing responses based on current Internet content, citing sources used.{{cite web | url = https://techcrunch.com/2023/04/04/ai-powered-search-engine-perplexity-ai-lands-26m-launches-ios-app/ | last = Wiggers | first = Kyle | date = April 5, 2023 | title = AI-powered search engine Perplexity AI lands $26M, launches iOS app | website = Techcrunch | access-date = May 5, 2024 | archive-date = March 5, 2024 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20240305054604/https://techcrunch.com/2023/04/04/ai-powered-search-engine-perplexity-ai-lands-26m-launches-ios-app/ | url-status = live }} Its real-time search engine ([[API]] service) is called Sonar and is based on [[Meta Platforms|Meta]]'s [[Llama (language model)|Llama]] model.{{Cite web |title=What advanced AI models are included in my subscription? {{!}} Perplexity Help Center |url=https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/10354919-what-advanced-ai-models-are-included-in-my-subscription |access-date=2026-03-28 |website=www.perplexity.ai |language=en}} A free public version is available, while a paid Pro subscription offers access to more advanced language models and additional features. Perplexity AI, Inc., was founded in August 2022{{cite web |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2025/06/24/tech/perplexity-ai-search-engine-meta-apple |title=What is Perplexity, the AI startup said to be catching Meta and Apple's attention |last=Eadicicco |first=Lisa |date=June 24, 2025 |website=CNN |access-date=Aug 4, 2025}} by Aravind Srinivas, [[Denis Yarats]], Johnny Ho, and [[Andy Konwinski]]. As of September 2025, the company was valued at US$20 billion.{{Cite web |last=Meenaktshi |first=Harshita |date=September 11, 2025 |editor-last=Barona |editor-first=Alan |title=Perplexity finalizes $20 billion valuation round, the Information reports |url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/perplexity-finalizes-20-billion-valuation-round-information-reports-2025-09-10/ |access-date=October 20, 2025 |website=[[Reuters]]}} Perplexity AI has faced legal scrutiny over allegations of [[copyright infringement]], unauthorized use of content, and trademark issues from several major media organizations, including the [[BBC]], [[Dow Jones]], and ''[[The New York Times]]''.{{Cite web|title=The NYT's cease and desist move against Perplexity AI {{!}} TechTarget|url=https://www.techtarget.com/searchenterpriseai/news/366613804/The-NYTs-cease-and-desist-move-against-Perplexity-AI|website=Search Enterprise AI|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en}}{{Cite web|title=Perplexity AI Faces Legal Challenges Over Copyright and Trademark Issues|url=https://neuron.expert/news/perplexity-ai-faces-legal-challenges-over-copyright-and-trademark-issues/12426/en/|website=neuron.expert|access-date=2025-11-28}} According to separate analyses by ''[[Wired (magazine)|Wired]]'' and, later, [[Cloudflare]], Perplexity uses undisclosed [[web crawler]]s with [[Spoofed URL|spoofed]] [[user-agent string]]s to [[Web scraping|scrape]] the content of websites that prohibit or explicitly block web scraping. == History == In August 2022, Perplexity AI, Inc., was founded by Aravind Srinivas, [[Denis Yarats]], Johnny Ho, and [[Andy Konwinski]], engineers with backgrounds in back-end systems, [[artificial intelligence]] (AI), and [[machine learning]].{{cite news |last1=Peluso |first1=Olivia |title=Who Is Aravind Srinivas, the Founder and CEO Behind $9B Perplexity AI? |url=https://observer.com/2025/03/perplexity-ai-ceo-aravind-srinivas/ |access-date=16 March 2025 |publisher=Observer |date=March 12, 2025}} It launched its main search engine on December 7, 2022, and has since released a [[Google Chrome]] extension and [[Mobile app|apps]] for [[iOS]] and [[Android (operating system)|Android]].{{Cite web |last=Wiggers |first=Kyle |date=January 23, 2025 |title=Perplexity launches an assistant for Android |url=https://techcrunch.com/2025/01/23/perplexity-launches-an-assistant-for-android/ |access-date=January 24, 2025 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US |archive-date=January 23, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250123214359/https://techcrunch.com/2025/01/23/perplexity-launches-an-assistant-for-android/ |url-status=live }} In February 2023, Perplexity reported two million unique visitors. By April 2024, Perplexity had raised $165 million in [[funding]], valuing the company at over $1 billion. As of June 2025, Perplexity closed a $500 million funding round, elevating its valuation to $14 billion.{{Cite web |last=Ghaffary|first=Shirin|date=May 12, 2025|title=AI Startup Perplexity Nears Funding at $14 Billion Value|website=[[Bloomberg News]]|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-05-12/ai-search-startup-perplexity-nears-funding-at-14-billion-value?srnd=phx-technology|access-date=2025-11-28}} Investors in Perplexity AI have included [[Jeff Bezos]], [[Tobias Lütke]], [[Nat Friedman]], [[Nvidia]], and [[Databricks]].{{cite news |last=Wiggers |first=Kyle |date=January 4, 2024 |title=AI-powered search engine Perplexity AI, now valued at $520M, raises $73.6M |url=https://techcrunch.com/2024/01/04/ai-powered-search-engine-perplexity-ai-now-valued-at-520m-raises-70m/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240107015233/https://techcrunch.com/2024/01/04/ai-powered-search-engine-perplexity-ai-now-valued-at-520m-raises-70m/ |archive-date=January 7, 2024 |access-date=January 7, 2024 |website=[[TechCrunch]] |language=en-US}}{{Cite web|title=Perplexity Raises Series A Funding Round|url=https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/announcing-our-series-a-funding-round-and-mobile-app-launch|website=www.perplexity.ai|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240422160036/https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/announcing-our-series-a-funding-round-and-mobile-app-launch|archive-date=2024-04-22|language=en}} Additionally, Perplexity has received funding from [[1789 Capital]], a [[venture capital]] firm notable for its association with [[Donald Trump Jr.]]{{Cite web |last= Nellis |first=Stephen |date=2025-09-30 |title=AI chip firm Cerebras raises $1.1 billion, adds Trump-linked 1789 Capital as investor |url=https://www.reuters.com/business/ai-chip-firm-cerebras-raises-11-billion-adds-trump-linked-1789-capital-investor-2025-09-30/ |website=Reuters |language=en-US |access-date=April 25, 2026}} During Bloomberg’s Tech Summit 2025, Srinivas shared that the company processed 780 million queries in May 2025, as it recorded more than 20% month-over-month growth, with around 30 million queries processed daily.{{Cite web |last=Malik |first=Aisha |date=2025-06-05 |title=Perplexity received 780 million queries last month, CEO says |url=https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/05/perplexity-received-780-million-queries-last-month-ceo-says/ |access-date=2025-06-07 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}} In July 2024, Perplexity announced the launch of a new publishers' program to share [[advertising revenue]] with partners.{{Cite web |last=Robison |first=Kylie |date=July 30, 2024 |title=Perplexity is cutting checks to publishers following plagiarism accusations |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/7/30/24208979/perplexity-publishers-program-ad-revenue-sharing-ai-time-fortune-der-spiegel |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250129005833/https://www.theverge.com/2024/7/30/24208979/perplexity-publishers-program-ad-revenue-sharing-ai-time-fortune-der-spiegel |archive-date=January 29, 2025 |access-date=August 4, 2024 |website=The Verge |language=en}} On January 18, 2025, the day before the [[Restrictions on TikTok in the United States|impending U.S. ban]] on the social media app [[TikTok]], Perplexity submitted a proposal for a merger with TikTok US.{{Cite web |last=Ha |first=Anthony |date=January 18, 2025 |title=Perplexity AI submits bid to merge with TikTok |url=https://techcrunch.com/2025/01/18/perplexity-ai-submits-bid-to-merge-with-tiktok/ |access-date=January 18, 2025 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=Perplexity AI bids to merge with TikTok US amid looming ban, source says |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/news/2025/01/18/tiktok-ban-perplexity-ai-potential-merger/77809771007/ |access-date=January 18, 2025 |website=USA TODAY |language=en-US}}{{Cite web|title=Perplexity AI has reportedly submitted an 11th-hour bid to save TikTok in the US|url=https://www.engadget.com/social-media/perplexity-ai-has-reportedly-submitted-an-11th-hour-bid-to-save-tiktok-in-the-us-215012514.html|website=www.engadget.com|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250118224832/https://www.engadget.com/social-media/perplexity-ai-has-reportedly-submitted-an-11th-hour-bid-to-save-tiktok-in-the-us-215012514.html|archive-date=2025-01-18|language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=Perplexity AI bids to merge with TikTok US, source says |url=https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/perplexity-ai-bids-merge-tiktok-us-source-says-4876451 |access-date=January 18, 2025 |website=CNA |language=en}} On August 12, 2025, Perplexity made a bid to purchase [[Google Chrome|Chrome]] from Google for $34.5 billion.{{Cite web |last=Roth |first=Emma |date=2025-08-12 |title=Perplexity offers to buy Google Chrome for $34.5 billion |url=https://www.theverge.com/news/758218/perplexity-google-chrome-bid-unsolicited-offer |access-date=2025-08-12 |website=The Verge |language=en-US}} Perplexity stated that the sale could remedy antitrust litigation against Google, in which a judge was considering compelling the sale of Chrome.{{Cite web|title=Exclusive {{!}} Perplexity Makes Longshot $34.5 Billion Offer for Chrome|url=https://www.wsj.com/tech/perplexity-ai-google-chrome-offer-5ddb7a22|website=The Wall Street Journal|date=2025-08-12|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en-US|first=Katherine|last=Blunt}} In December 2025, [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] took an undisclosed stake in Perplexity AI and entered a global brand partnership with the company.{{cite news |title=Cristiano Ronaldo Invests in Perplexity AI, Enters Partnership |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-12-05/cristiano-ronaldo-invests-in-perplexity-ai-enters-partnership-misnf0af |publisher=Bloomberg |date=5 December 2025}} As of early 2026, Perplexity AI reached a valuation of $21.21 billion following its Series E-6 funding round. In January 2026, the company entered into a three-year, $750 million commitment with Microsoft Azure to secure GPU capacity.{{citation needed|date=June 2026}} In February 2026, Perplexity transitioned to a subscription-first model by discontinuing its AI-integrated advertising strategy.{{cite web |last1=MacRumors |title=Perplexity abandons AI advertising strategy over trust worries |url=https://www.macrumors.com/2026/02/18/perplexity-abandons-ai-advertising/ |date=February 18, 2026 |access-date=March 9, 2026}} Leadership stated the move was intended to preserve user trust in the "answer engine," prioritizing objective results over ad revenue. == Products and services == {{Infobox software | logo = [[File:Perplexity AI logo.svg|frameless|upright=1.2|class=skin-invert-image]] | screenshot = [[File:Perplexity AI What is Vilnius screenshot.webp|frameless|upright=1.2]] | caption = Screenshot of Perplexity AI answer to "What is [[Vilnius]]" prompt | developer = {{plainlist| * Aravind Srinivas * [[Denis Yarats]] * Johnny Ho * [[Andy Konwinski]]{{cite web | url = https://golden.com/wiki/Perplexity_AI-X9D5GWB | title = Perplexity AI | website = Golden | access-date = August 7, 2023 | archive-date = August 7, 2023 | archive-url =https://web.archive.org/web/20230807111225/https://golden.com/wiki/Perplexity_AI-X9D5GWB | url-status = live }} }} | released = {{Start date and age|2022|12|07}} | engine = {{plainlist| * [[GPT-5.5]] * [[Claude (language model)|Claude Opus 4.7]] * [[Gemini (language model)|Gemini 3.1 Pro]] * [[Kimi (chatbot)|Kimi K2.6]] * Sonar 2 }} | genre = {{plainlist| * [[Search engine]] * [[Large language model]] * [[Generative pre-trained transformer]] }} | website = {{URL|https://www.perplexity.ai/|perplexity.ai}} }} ===Search engine web portal=== Perplexity’s primary offering is an online information retrieval system ([[search engine]]) that uses large language models to generate responses to user queries by searching and summarizing web-based content. Perplexity offers a feature known as Perplexity Pages that generates structured summaries and report-like content from user queries by aggregating cited sources.{{cite news |last=David |first=Emilia |date=May 30, 2024 |title=Perplexity will research and write reports |url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/5/30/24167986/perplexity-ai-research-pages-school-report |access-date=June 24, 2024 |website=[[The Verge]] |language=en |archive-date=June 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240620005155/https://www.theverge.com/2024/5/30/24167986/perplexity-ai-research-pages-school-report |url-status=live }} Perplexity is available to web users without charge or registration, a [[freemium]] model.{{Cite news |last=Ghaffary |first=Shirin |date=April 23, 2024 |title=AI Search Startup Perplexity Valued at $1 Billion in Funding Round |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-04-23/ai-search-startup-perplexity-valued-at-1-billion-in-funding-round |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240424015839/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-04-23/ai-search-startup-perplexity-valued-at-1-billion-in-funding-round |archive-date=April 24, 2024 |access-date= |work=[[Bloomberg News]] |language=}} === Perplexity Pro === Perplexity Pro is a subscription tier, a more capable paid "enterprise" service, including stronger security and data protection and additional tools, including the ability to search uploaded documents alongside web content and access to a programmatic application programming interface (API). It allows the user to select between backend models such as [[GPT-5.4]], [[Claude (language model)#Claude 4|Claude 4.6]], and [[Gemini (language model)|Gemini 3.1 Pro]].{{cite news |last=Singh |first=Shubham |date=January 6, 2024 |title=Perplexity AI raises $73.6M in funding round led by Nvidia, Bezos, now valued at $522M |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/entrepreneurship/start-up/story/perplexity-ai-raises-736m-in-funding-round-led-by-nvidia-bezos-now-valued-at-522m-412130-2024-01-06 |access-date=January 12, 2024 |website=[[Business Today (India)|Business Today]] |archive-date=August 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240820230917/https://www.businesstoday.in/entrepreneurship/start-up/story/perplexity-ai-raises-736m-in-funding-round-led-by-nvidia-bezos-now-valued-at-522m-412130-2024-01-06 |url-status=live }} The company has also developed its own models, Sonar (based on [[Llama (language model)|Llama]] 3.3){{Cite web|title=Perplexity AI launches new ultra-fast AI search model Sonar|url=https://the-decoder.com/perplexity-ai-launches-new-ultra-fast-ai-search-model-sonar/|website=THE DECODER|date=2025-02-12|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en-US|first=Maximilian|last=Schreiner}} and R1 1776 (based on [[DeepSeek]] R1).{{Cite web |last=Jindal |first=Siddharth |date=2025-02-19 |title=Perplexity AI Open-Sources R1 1776 to Remove Censorship from DeepSeek-R1 |url=https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news-updates/perplexity-ai-open-sources-r1-1776-to-remove-censorship-from-deepseek-r1/ |access-date=2025-06-06 |website=Analytics India Magazine |language=en-US}} === Internal Knowledge Search === Internal Knowledge Search enables Pro and Enterprise Pro users to browse web content and their internal documents simultaneously. Moreover, it allows users to upload and search through files in Excel, Word, PDF, and other common file formats. Enterprise Pro users can upload and index up to 500 files.{{Cite web |last=David |first=Emilia |date=October 17, 2024 |title=Perplexity lets you search your internal enterprise files and the web |url=https://venturebeat.com/ai/perplexity-lets-you-search-your-internal-enterprise-files-and-the-web/ |access-date=December 18, 2024 |website=VentureBeat |language=en-US |archive-date=December 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241220042151/https://venturebeat.com/ai/perplexity-lets-you-search-your-internal-enterprise-files-and-the-web/ |url-status=live }} === Search API === Perplexity's Search API provides AI developers with programmatic access to the company's search infrastructure. The September 2025 release includes a [[software development kit]], an [[open-source]] evaluation framework called ''search_evals'', and documentation detailing the API's design and optimization.{{Cite web |last=Hawley |first=Michelle |title=Perplexity Launches Search API for AI Developers |url=https://www.vktr.com/ai-news/perplexity-launches-search-api-for-ai-developers/ |access-date=2025-09-26 |website=VKTR.com |language=en}} === Shopping hub === Perplexity's Shopping Hub is an [[online shopping]] platform that provides AI-generated product recommendations and enables users to purchase products directly through Perplexity's interface.{{Cite news|title=AI startup Perplexity adds shopping features as search competition tightens|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/artificial-intelligence/ai-startup-perplexity-adds-shopping-features-as-search-competition-tightens/articleshow/115433627.cms|work=The Economic Times|date=2024-11-19|access-date=2025-11-28|issn=0013-0389}} It was launched in November 2024 with backing by [[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] and [[Nvidia]].{{Cite news |date=November 18, 2024 |title=AI startup Perplexity adds shopping features as search competition tightens |url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/ai-startup-perplexity-adds-shopping-features-search-competition-tightens-2024-11-18/ |access-date=November 21, 2024 |work=[[Reuters]] |language=en}} === Finance === In October 2024, Perplexity AI introduced new finance-related features, including software that tracks stock prices and company earnings data in real time. The tool provides real-time stock quotes and price tracking, industry peer comparisons, and basic financial analysis tools. The platform sources its financial data from Financial Modeling Prep.{{Cite news|title=AI Startup Perplexity Closes Funding Round at $9 Billion Value|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-12-18/ai-startup-perplexity-closes-funding-round-at-9-billion-value|work=Bloomberg.com|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250205173531/https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-12-18/ai-startup-perplexity-closes-funding-round-at-9-billion-value|archive-date=2025-02-05|language=en}}{{Cite web |first=Steven |last=Vaughan-Nichols |title=Perplexity AI's new tool makes researching the stock market 'delightful'. Here's how |url=https://www.zdnet.com/article/perplexity-ais-new-tool-makes-researching-the-stock-market-delightful-heres-how/ |date=October 21, 2024 |access-date=December 18, 2024 |website=ZDNET |language=en |archive-date=December 19, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241219110947/https://www.zdnet.com/article/perplexity-ais-new-tool-makes-researching-the-stock-market-delightful-heres-how/ |url-status=live }} === Assistant === In January 2025, Perplexity launched the Perplexity Assistant, an AI-powered tool designed to enhance its search engine's functionality. It can perform tasks across multiple apps, such as [[Ridesharing company|hailing a ride]] or searching for a song, and can maintain context across actions. The assistant is also multi-modal, meaning it can use a phone's camera to provide answers about the user's surroundings or on-screen content. Perplexity has acknowledged that the assistant is still in development and may not always function as expected. For instance, certain features, such as summarizing unread emails or upcoming calendar events, require users to enable a workaround based on notifications. === Comet === In July 2025, Perplexity launched [[Comet (browser)|Comet]], an [[AI browser]] based on [[Chromium (web browser)|Chromium]]. Initially, access to the browser was limited to users subscribed to the most expensive subscription tier.{{Cite web |last=Schräer |first=Frank |date=2025-07-10 |title=Perplexity's own browser "Comet" with integrated AI agents now available |url=https://www.heise.de/en/news/Perplexity-s-own-browser-Comet-with-integrated-AI-agents-now-available-10481861.html |access-date=2025-07-18 |website=heise online |language=en}} The browser was later released for free download in October 2025.{{Cite web |last=Peterson |first=Jake |date=2025-10-03 |title=Perplexity's AI Browser Is Now Available for Free for Everyone |url=https://lifehacker.com/tech/perplexitys-ai-comet-browser-free |access-date=2025-10-05 |website=Lifehacker |language=en}} A key feature is the integration of the Perplexity search engine,{{Cite web |last=Zeff |first=Maxwell |date=2025-07-09 |title=Perplexity launches Comet, an AI-powered web browser |url=https://techcrunch.com/2025/07/09/perplexity-launches-comet-an-ai-powered-web-browser/ |access-date=2025-07-18 |website=TechCrunch |language=en-US}} which can perform a variety of tasks such as generating article summaries, describing an image, conducting research about a topic, and composing emails.{{Cite web|title=Perplexity's Comet is the AI browser Google wants|url=https://www.theverge.com/news/709025/perplexity-comet-ai-browser-chrome-competitor|website=The Verge|date=2025-07-18|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en-US|first=Emma|last=Roth}} === Truth Social chatbot === Perplexity has been contracted to produce a chatbot for [[Donald Trump]]'s social media platform [[Truth Social]].{{cite news |last1=Myers|first1=Steven Lee|last2=Thompson|first2=Stuart A.|title=Right-Wing Chatbots Turbocharge America's Political and Cultural Wars|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/04/business/right-wing-chatbots-gab-arya-chatgpt-gemini.html|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=November 4, 2025|access-date=2025-11-28}} == Leadership == Aravind Srinivas is the CEO and co-founder of Perplexity AI.{{Cite web |title=Aravind Srinivas: Meet the Perplexity AI CEO Who Became One of India's Youngest Billionaires |url=https://thetoolx.com/blog/aravind-srinivas-meet-the-perplexity-ai-ceo-who-became-one-of-indias-youngest-billionaires |access-date=2025-10-03 |website=thetoolx.com}}{{Cite web |last=Peluso |access-date=2025-05-10 |website=Observer |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=Sharma |first=Nonika |date=2025-02-10 |title=Who Is Aravind Srinivas, CEO Who Has Challenged Elon Musk Over USAID News outlet Forbes says it's ripping them off|url=https://apnews.com/article/perplexity-ai-search-engine-forbes-f307cb607f0db871b05f843a3f744340|work=AP News|date=2024-06-14|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240620100507/https://apnews.com/article/perplexity-ai-search-engine-forbes-f307cb607f0db871b05f843a3f744340|archive-date=2024-06-20|language=en|last=O'Brien|first=Matt}}{{Cite web|title=FQA Mạng xã hội học sinh, giải bài tập, hỏi đáp AI|url=https://fqa.vn/|website=fqa.vn|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en}}{{Cite news|title=Why Perplexity's Cynical Theft Represents Everything That Could Go Wrong With AI|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/randalllane/2024/06/11/why-perplexitys-cynical-theft-represents-everything-that-could-go-wrong-with-ai/|work=Forbes|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en|first=Randall|last=Lane|date=June 11, 2024}} In October 2024, ''[[The New York Times]]'' sent a [[Cease and desist|cease-and-desist]] notice to Perplexity demanding that it stop accessing and using NYT content, claiming that Perplexity is violating its copyright by [[web scraping|scraping]] data from its website.{{Cite news|title=The New York Times warns AI search engine Perplexity to stop using its content|url=https://www.theverge.com/2024/10/15/24270774/new-york-times-cease-and-desist-letter-perplexity-ai-search-engine|work=The Verge|date=2024-10-15|access-date=2025-11-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241112204218/https://www.theverge.com/2024/10/15/24270774/new-york-times-cease-and-desist-letter-perplexity-ai-search-engine|archive-date=2024-11-12|language=en|last=Davis|first=Wes}} In June 2024, [[Dow Jones]] and ''[[New York Post]]'' filed a lawsuit against Perplexity, alleging copyright infringement. The lawsuit also alleged that Perplexity harmed their brand by attributing [[Hallucination (AI)|hallucinated]] quotes, for example, on F-16 jets for Ukraine, to articles that did not include them.{{Cite news|title=Wall Street Journal, New York Post Sue AI Startup Perplexity, Alleging 'Massive On October 24, 2024, Perplexity AI published an official response on its company blog asserting that the claims in the lawsuits were misleading and stating it was open to revenue-sharing arrangements scraping|url=https://techcrunch.com/2025/08/04/perplexity-accused-of-scraping-websites-that-explicitly-blocked-ai-scraping/|website=TechCrunch|date=2025-08-04|access-date=2025-11-28|language=en-US|first=Lorenzo|last=Franceschi-Bicchierai}} Perplexity AI, Inc., or simply Perplexity, is an American privately held software company offering a web search engine that processes user queries and synthesizes responses. Perplexity products use large language models and incorporate real-time web search capabilities, providing responses based on current Internet content, citing sources used. Its real-time search engine (API service) is called Sonar and is based on Meta's Llama model. A free public version is available, while a paid Pro subscription offers access to more advanced language models and additional features.
Perplexity AI, Inc., was founded in August 2022 by Aravind Srinivas, Denis Yarats, Johnny Ho, and Andy Konwinski. As of September 2025, the company was valued at US$20 billion.
Perplexity AI has faced legal scrutiny over allegations of copyright infringement, unauthorized use of content, and trademark issues from several major media organizations, including the BBC, Dow Jones, and The New York Times. According to separate analyses by Wired and, later, Cloudflare, Perplexity uses undisclosed web crawlers with spoofed user-agent strings to scrape the content of websites that prohibit or explicitly block web scraping.
